# Certificates over fault envelopes: sound, available exactly where separated

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`certificates-sound-and-available` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F05 · [record](certificates-sound-and-available.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A certificate over an envelope of admitted fault sets is sound wherever the actual fault set is admitted, and available for every admitted fault set exactly where every two leave a domain outside both; pooling models keeps soundness and can lose availability; an interrupted search is pending.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A certificate holds where the envelope is not empty and, for every admitted fault set, some domain of the roster outside it supports. An accepted certificate gives each admitted fault set a supporting domain outside it, so whatever every faithful domain outside the actual fault set warrants holds wherever that fault set is admitted. (`Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate_iff`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate_witness`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate_sound`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. The envelope is separated where every two admitted fault sets leave a domain outside both. Separated, and every domain outside the actual admitted fault set supporting, the certificate holds; support only inside one admitted fault set is rejected; and with support from exactly the domains outside the actual set, the certificate holds for every admitted actual set exactly where the envelope is separated. (`Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.separated`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.certificate_available`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.support_inside_fault_rejected`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.availability_iff_separated`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Where the actual fault set and one admitted fault set together cover the roster, support from exactly the domains outside the actual set is rejected; an empty envelope, or one admitting the whole roster, certifies nothing; a stronger envelope, each fault set of a nonempty weaker one lying within one of its own, accepts only what the weaker accepts. (`Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.covering_faults_reject`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.empty_envelope_rejects`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.total_fault_rejects`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.stronger_envelope_no_new_acceptance`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Named envelopes: one fault among three domains, and a correlated pair among four, are separated; a correlated pair among three blocks the certificate when only the domain outside the pair supports. (`Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.one_fault_separation`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.correlated_four_separation`, `Becoming.FaultEnvelopes.correlated_three_blocks`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Where several causal models remain, the pool holds every fault set any of them admits, and an inquiry keeps the models agreeing with its answer. The actual model survives every faithful test, its faults lie in the pool, and a certificate over the pool is sound, for covered causes, whichever remaining model is actual. (`Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.pooled`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.retain`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.retained_truth`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.model_faults_in_pool`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.pooled_certificate_sound`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. Narrowing the models narrows the pool, keeps an accepted certificate while the pool is not empty, and keeps a separated pool separated; an empty family certifies nothing. In the computed case of three models of four members, each model is ready while their pool is not; a diagnosis need not identify the model, and a misleading one can accept only compromised support. (`Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.pooled_subset`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.refinement_preserves_certificate`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.refinement_preserves_separation`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.empty_family_rejects`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.poolReady`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.every_candidate_ready_pool_not`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.diagnosis_not_identifying`, `Becoming.PooledEnvelopes.misleading_diagnosis_accepts_compromised`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. A search within a number of inspections finds only what is there; a search ending exhausted had no inhabited entry on its frontier; with inspections at least the frontier's nodes it is not left pending, and an inhabited tree is found. Stopped after one inspection, the search of a fork of a closed branch and an endpoint is pending; with three it finds it; a search can find an endpoint with part of the tree unread. (`Becoming.TreeSearch.scan`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.discover`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.scan_sound`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.discover_sound`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.exhausted_dead`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.scan_settles`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.inhabited_discovered`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.interrupted_pending`, `Becoming.TreeSearch.found_without_complete_map`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The roster, the envelopes and the faithfulness of domains outside the actual fault set are supplied, as is, for pooling, coverage of the actual causes by a remaining model.
- The search inspects a supplied tree that does not change during the search; one inspection reads one node.
- No premise: every FaultEnvelopes, PooledEnvelopes and TreeSearch declaration has an empty axiom report; they restate the periphery correction modules, which use propext and Quot.sound in some declarations and Classical.choice in six execution, dispatch and completion laws not restated here, as their receipts report.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That an envelope matches the actual shared causes: the envelope is supplied by an analysis the certificate does not check.
- Byzantine agreement, legitimate initial authority or a cryptographic implementation.
- Absence from a search that stops: an interrupted search is pending, and only exhaustion of the frontier shows that nothing is there. Witness: `Becoming.TreeSearch.interrupted_pending`.
- **Counterexample:** Three models of four members: each is ready, their pool is not (every_candidate_ready_pool_not). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PooledEnvelopes.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A correlated pair among three domains blocks the certificate (correlated_three_blocks). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/FaultEnvelopes.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Availability exactly where no two admitted fault sets cover the roster is the Q² condition on adversary structures (Hirt and Maurer 2000); the envelope plays the role of a fail-prone system for Byzantine quorums (Malkhi and Reiter 1998), whose existence conditions ask more (no three fail-prone sets covering the servers); the certificate is a quorum test, not agreement.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- none
- related, not a proved adapter: [fallible-witness-diagnosability](fallible-witness-diagnosability.md). Two answers are told apart on a complete report exactly where their envelopes are cross-separated; here a certificate for one statement.
- related, not a proved adapter: [copied-witnesses-change-nothing](copied-witnesses-change-nothing.md). Copied witnesses leave the certificate of FaultEnvelopes unchanged.
- related, not a proved adapter: [evidence-through-change](evidence-through-change.md). The pooled certificate kept sound along every lawful history of admitted change.
